import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    rate_feed = inputs["RATE_FEED"].copy()

    # Preserve original row order for stable tie-breaking on duplicate keys
    rate_feed = rate_feed.reset_index(drop=False).rename(columns={"index": "_orig_idx"})

    # Cursor ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq (stable sort preserves
    # original relative order for exact duplicate keys)
    rate_feed = rate_feed.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    )

    # Carry-forward last non-null rate within each account only (never crosses
    # account boundaries) using forward-fill grouped by account_id.
    rate_feed["rate_filled"] = rate_feed.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    # carried = 1 only when original rate was null AND a prior rate existed
    # within the same account (i.e., rate_filled is not null).
    was_null = rate_feed["rate"].isna()
    has_fill = rate_feed["rate_filled"].notna()
    rate_feed["was_carried"] = (was_null & has_fill).astype("int64")

    result = rate_feed[
        ["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"rate_filled": result}
